Context: 8. Family means-

12. 'Emoluments' for the purpose of retirement/ death gratuity means 'pay' as defined in FR 9 (21) (a) (i), i.e., basic pay (substantive or officiating), non-practising allowance and dearness allowance on the date of retirement/ death. When there is reduction in the 'emoluments' during the last ten months of service, gratuity may be based on 'average emoluments' for the last ten months instead of 'emoluments'. - Rule 45 (6).
